text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 24px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #142d4e
font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #516174

g.text: Integrated ATLANTIS implementation • synchronous Boolean dynamics • source-aligned control flow

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #2774ae

g.text: Network F; user-selected T; engine; counting mode; shots; QPE precision p; budgets
Validate rules and settings; compile ANF; check qubits, memory and synthesis limits
Reject infeasible requests; require an authorized executor for IBM execution

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #516174

g.text: N = 2ⁿ; C = verified cycles; E = all states in C
M = number of x with Fᵀ(x) in E
Evolution: n(T+1) qubits; QPE adds p

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #2774ae
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #142d4e

g.text: C = ∅; round r = 0; initialize measurements and audit history

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #2774ae
font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #142d4e
font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #142d4e
font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #2774ae

g.text: If selected, audit all Fᵀ(x); full coverage → classical certificate
Otherwise count M by exact enumeration, ideal-QPE reference, or actual QPE
Apply the stopping / validity rules at right before computing suppression

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #516174
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #516174
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #b77a18

g.text: Classical audit: all N terminals in E
Any remaining M outside 0 < M < N

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #2774ae
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #516174
font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #2774ae

g.text: Initialize H⊗ⁿ|0ⁿ⟩; if C ≠ ∅, repeat J times:
U_F → phase E by −φ → U_F† → H⊗ⁿ P₀(φ) H⊗ⁿ
Apply U_F; measure terminal register with configured shots
Reference mode samples its ideal distribution; circuit modes execute compiled circuits

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #087f8c

g.text: Bounded trajectory tracing; accept only states belonging to a verified cycle
Canonicalize cycles; reject transients, unresolved candidates and known cycles
Retain accepted unseen cycles with their measurement weights

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #142d4e
font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #b77a18

g.text: retry search with the same C and M

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #516174
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #516174

g.text: Select one accepted cycle by measurement weight; add to C; r ← r+1

g.text: Perform a final policy-specific coverage check
Classical audit / exact count: certify if full
Export cycles, status, counts and resources

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #516174
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #142d4e

g.text: QPE completion remains heuristic; exhaustive certification costs O(2ⁿT).
Exact-M and ideal-QPE references enumerate Fᵀ. Candidate verification is bounded.
Cancellation, deadlines and execution errors are recorded by the job layer.
